338231.title: My First Custom LLM – An Introduction to LoRA & QLoRA Fine-Tuning

“Take the first step toward creating your own customized LLM with lightweight LoRA-based fine-tuning!”

With complex theory kept to a minimum, it guides you step by step through the entire process: loading a model → applying data → training → comparing results.

In a short amount of time, you’ll directly experience the workflow of modern lightweight fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA,  
and gain an intuitive understanding of “how LLM fine-tuning actually works.”

Even without extensive resources, experience the sense of accomplishment that comes from creating an LLM specialized for your own domain!
abilities: You can easily understand what fine-tuning is and why LoRA and QLoRA are needed.
You will experience the process of running prepared code, directly loading a small language model (sLLM), and training it.
Learn the workflow for creating a customized LLM tailored to your field, without requiring extensive resources or difficult theory.

Data preprocessing and visualization: Handle missing values and outliers, and use graphs to discover the characteristics and hidden patterns in the data.
Build predictive models with machine learning: You can implement linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, and random forests yourself and interpret the prediction results.
Evaluating and improving machine learning models: You can compare and improve model performance using cross-validation, pipelines, and hyperparameter tuning.
Analyzing Customer Reviews and Text: You can extract useful information from reviews and documents using text preprocessing, TF-IDF, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling.

Learn the basics of time series data analysis: identify trends and seasonality in data over time and understand the principles of analysis using moving averages.

Understanding the Core Principles of Deep Learning and Transformers: You can explain the basic structures and learning principles of artificial neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers.
